title: Armed drug suspect with P380,000 'shabu' arrested in Tagaytay

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY—Anti-narcotics operatives arrested an armed suspected high-value drug trafficker, seizing over P380,000 worth of “shabu” (crystal meth) and an undocumented firearm in a buy-bust operation in Tagaytay City, Cavite, on Tuesday morning. The Cavite Police Provincial Office reported that the suspect was arrested at around 7 a.m. after allegedly selling P500 worth of shabu to an undercover police operative in Barangay Sambong, Seized from the suspect were two heat-sealed plastic sachets containing suspected shabu weighing a total of 55.9 grams.
